title: Oil Rich Kenyan Hazelnuts Flatbread
description: A jammy, dense, and delicious Kenyan dish featuring hazelnuts, perfect for a lazy Sunday, made with long-fermentation-dough and ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, salt, and sugar.
Gradually add water and olive oil to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it ferment for 8 hours.
Punch down the dough and roll it out into a flat circle.
Spread chopped hazelnuts evenly over the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges over the hazelnuts to form a crust.
Bake the flatbread for 25 minutes or until it is golden brown.
